title: Trained MaleCNS - Front Nine, round 16
description: The trained golfer's round seed 16, one of ten rounds (seeds 7-16) recorded with readout 20260917T165536Z. Every stroke starts from 400 ms of simulated activity across all 166,700 MaleCNS neurons; a readout fitted offline from practice shots turns descending-neuron firing into a club, an aim and a power. The connectome itself never learns.

controller.label: MaleCNS + TRAINED READOUT
controller.description: The same MaleCNS v1.0 connectome simulation. Club, aim and power are read out of descending-neuron activity by weights fitted offline from practice shots (a putter gate, a club head and putter / full-swing heads; docs/TRAINING.md). The connectome's synapses are unchanged.

notes: 42 local file path(s) replaced with '<local path removed>'
trajectory samples rounded to 4 decimals (0.1 mm, 0.1 ms) for size; the source run re-simulates bit for bit with `fly-golf replay 20260917T172650Z-ac87ed`

controller.label: MaleCNS + TRAINED READOUT
controller.description: The same MaleCNS v1.0 connectome simulation. Club, aim and power are read out of descending-neuron activity by weights fitted offline from practice shots (a putter gate, a club head and putter / full-swing heads; docs/TRAINING.md). The connectome's synapses are unchanged.

club_chain.senses: proxy sensory channels injected into MaleCNS sensory neurons; 400 ms simulated
club_chain.rule: putter if p_putt >= 0.5, else club index = round(calibrated club head), lob wedge..driver
